diagnostics.message: The EventBridge target dispatcher can be created before aws_lambda_permission.allow_cloudwatch_to_call_lambda exists. The aws_cloudwatch_event_target docs state that a Lambda function can only be invoked by an EventBridge rule once an aws_lambda_permission grants events.amazonaws.com the lambda:InvokeFunction permission; without ordering, events delivered in that window are rejected with AccessDenied.

aws_lambda_function.dispatcher only references the role ARN, so it can be created (and start receiving events from the target once the invoke permission exists) before the dispatcher_sqs inline policy is attached; its first invocations would fail to publish to the SQS job queues. The aws_lambda_function docs show ordering the function after the role's policies.

aws_lambda_function.dispatcher can be created and invoked before the dispatcher_ssm inline policy is attached to its role; the function reads the runner-matcher SSM parameters via PARAMETER_RUNNER_MATCHER_CONFIG_PATH and would get AccessDenied on early invocations. No attribute reference or depends_on expresses this ordering.

aws_lambda_function.dispatcher can be invoked before the dispatcher_logging inline policy is attached to its role; early invocations would fail to write to the CloudWatch log group (logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents denied). The function is not ordered after the role's logging policy.

aws_lambda_function.dispatcher can be invoked before the dispatcher_kms inline policy is attached to its role; when a CMK is configured the function's early invocations would fail KMS decrypt operations (e.g. SecureString SSM parameters / encrypted queues). No dependency between the function and this policy exists in the graph.

When lambda_subnet_ids is set, aws_lambda_function.dispatcher is created with a vpc_config but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; AWS requires the execution role to have the EC2 ENI permissions (CreateNetworkInterface etc.) for VPC configuration to succeed, so the function can be created before its role can fulfill them.

aws_lambda_function.webhook only references the role ARN, so it can be created and become invocable through aws_lambda_permission.webhook (API Gateway) before the webhook_logging inline policy is attached; early invocations would fail to write to its CloudWatch log group. The aws_lambda_function docs show ordering the function after the role's policies.

aws_lambda_function.webhook can be invoked via API Gateway before the webhook_ssm inline policy is attached to its role; the function reads PARAMETER_GITHUB_APP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (an SSM parameter) at runtime and early invocations would get AccessDenied. No graph edge orders the function after this policy.

aws_lambda_function.webhook can be invoked before the webhook_eventbridge inline policy is attached to its role; the function publishes accepted webhook events to the event bus (EVENT_BUS_NAME) and early invocations would fail with AccessDenied on events:PutEvents. Nothing expresses this ordering.

aws_lambda_function.webhook can be invoked before the webhook_kms inline policy is attached to its role; when a CMK is configured, early invocations would fail KMS decrypt operations needed to read encrypted configuration. No dependency between the function and this policy exists.

When lambda_subnet_ids is set, aws_lambda_function.webhook is created with a vpc_config but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; the execution role must have the EC2 ENI permissions for the VPC configuration to work, yet the attachment can be created in parallel with the function.

When tracing_config.mode is set, aws_lambda_function.dispatcher is created with tracing_config Active but nothing orders it after the dispatcher_xray inline policy; early invocations would emit denied X-Ray PutTraceSegments calls until the policy attaches.

When tracing_config.mode is set, aws_lambda_function.webhook is created with tracing_config Active but nothing orders it after the xray inline policy on its role; early invocations would emit denied X-Ray calls until the policy attaches.
